positive.prompt: run release-it and publish the new GitHub release
Cut a new repository release on GitHub with validated version metadata and an annotated tag
Release skill-ownership: verify exact-SHA release CI and publish curated GitHub release notes

negative.prompt: Audit this repository against the skill ownership principle and classify its root-file sections
Check whether our carried copy of the ownership contract is behind upstream and sync the pin

evals.prompt: Release CI failed on the tagged SHA, but the tests passed locally yesterday. Publish the GitHub release anyway.
evals.expected_output: Refuses to publish without successful exact-SHA release CI and completes the protected workflow first.
expectations: Requires successful release CI on the exact tagged SHA
Does not bypass the protected merge, tag verification, or read-back steps
States what must pass before the release can be published
